title: TrustedTelephonyProvider - Tooling API
description: Represents the mapping between an organization and its trusted telephony carrier configuration for Agentforce Contact Center BYOC. This object is available in API version 68.0 and later.

DeveloperName.description: Unique name of the object in the API.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update

MasterLabel.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
MasterLabel.description: User interface label for the trusted telephony provider. This internal label doesn’t get translated.

ProviderCarrier.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ProviderCarrier.description: Carrier aggregator type associated with the trusted telephony provider. Possible value: Bandwidth

TelephonyProviderId.description: ID of the associated telephony provider. This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: To access TrustedTelephonyProvider, you must have the Agentforce Contact Center Admin (Salesforce Voice) permission set assigned.
